about: ARX-GLIMEPIRIDE (glimepiride, a long-acting sulfonylurea) is supplied every month from December 2025 and the record has a type 2 diabetes mellitus line.
Possible finding: the record holds no line about type 2 diabetes; Daonil (glibenclamide) is supplied with metformin, so diabetes is likely but not recorded.
Type 2 diabetes is recorded, and the patient switches from immediate-release glipizide to modified-release gliclazide, both outside Group A.
